description: Main React component for the Mobile Web Service Repair Portal, handling customer repair requests and admin login/view.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a temporary toast message of a given type and message.

methods.name: handleCustomerSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the customer repair request form, calls API, and resets form on success.

methods.name: handleAdminLogin
methods.description: Handles admin login, retrieves repair requests, and manages login state.

methods.name: handleRefreshRepairs
methods.description: Refreshes the list of repair requests from the server.
